description: Carrying out a feasibility study on the construction of Three Dry Dams in the Kalu Ganga Basin for Flood Mitigation
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-03-30 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The Kalu Ganga Basin, which has a catchment area of 2,839 square kilometers, is considered to be the most flood-prone river basin in the country due to its frequent flooding and flood-related damages. Therefore, a pre-feasibility study has been conducted to identify strategies to protect the residents and infrastructure of the Kalu Ganga Basin from flood damage. Following the said feasibility study, the recommendation for the construction of three dry dams at Malwala, Dela II and Dela III has been identified as appropriate to be accorded priority, from among the recommendations made for potential flood protection measures in the basin. Accordingly, it has been planned to carry out a feasibility study for the construction of the three dry dams. The proposal made by the Minister of Agriculture, Livestock, Lands and Irrigation to award the consultancy services contract of the said feasibility study to the Central Engineering Consultancy Bureau, was approved by the Cabinet.
